pages.text: Blue Skies adds two T2 dimensions: Everbright (light/order) and Everdawn (dark/chaos). Elemental combat throughout.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Elemental damage in Blue Skies bypasses standard armor. Magic resistance (Sorcery tree, Battlemage class) is more valuable here than raw armor stats.$(br2)$(bold)Bosses:$(/bold) Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, and Arachnarch each drop a Simply Swords unique.

$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$(/bold) Blue Skies has 641 loot tables — they've been bulk-covered by the loot overhaul. Token injection rates are slightly higher here than Twilight Forest to account for the dimension's density.

$(bold)No guide book.$(/bold) Blue Skies is exploration-driven. Both dimensions — the Everbright and the Everdawn — contain dungeon loot and boss encounters that guide you forward naturally. JEI covers all crafting recipes.
